title: Spaces Multipart Upload For Hydra Artifacts
description: Uploads artifacts larger than 5GB with the S3 multipart API and adds produce --from-artifact so the 6.3GB Hydra dump on lon1 can be published without repeating anonymisation.

test_plan.description: Publish the recovered Hydra dump without repeating produce
steps: Merge this PR and wait for semantic-release to publish a new ngramx.phar
Do not dispatch a full Hydra produce
Confirm hydra/hydra_anon.sql.gz lands in weathered-brook-anonymized-backups and latest.json matches size 6755282413
Confirm shared hydra_prod_anon refresh starts after the upload

test_plan.description: PHPStan on PHP 8.2 and 8.3 is clean
steps: Confirm the Tests workflow PHP 8.2 and PHP 8.3 jobs pass
Then recover the lon1 dump with produce --from-artifact as in the previous block
Confirm produce --from-artifact --all exits before touching datasets
